A moderate-pace Lisbon stay with one scenic day trip, transit-friendly lodging, local food, and one free evening built into the schedule. Costs below are estimated for 2 adults and stay within your **€1,600** budget excluding international flights.

# Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary and Budget

## Day 1 — Arrival, Baixa, and Alfama
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Arrive in Lisbon, check into a hotel near **Baixa/Chiado, Rossio, or Avenida** for easy metro/train access.
- Afternoon: Walk **Baixa, Rossio, and Alfama**; stop at **Lisbon Cathedral** and a miradouro for city views.
- Evening: Dinner in Alfama with simple fado-adjacent neighborhood atmosphere; keep the pace light after travel.
- Rationale: This clusters central neighborhoods so you can settle in without transport stress and get an immediate feel for the city.
- Estimated cost: Hotel €150, meals €70, local transit €10, sights €20, total **€250**

## Day 2 — Museums, Tram-Style Neighborhoods, and Local Food
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- Morning: Visit **Museu Nacional do Azulejo** or **Calouste Gulbenkian Museum** depending on your art preference.
- Afternoon: Explore **Graça** and **Mouraria** on foot; pause for coffee, pastries, and viewpoints.
- Evening: Free relaxation evening with no scheduled activities; optional casual dinner near the hotel.
- Rationale: A museum day balances walking with indoor time, and the free evening keeps the trip from feeling rushed.
- Estimated cost: Museum tickets €30, meals €80, transit €12, snacks/coffee €18, total **€140**

## Day 3 — Scenic Day Trip to Sintra
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/train-front.svg
- Morning: Take the train to **Sintra** early; visit **Pena Palace** or **Quinta da Regaleira**.
- Afternoon: Continue with one more scenic stop in Sintra town or the gardens at **Monserrate** if energy allows.
Media: Alt=Afternoon: Continue with one more scenic stop in Sintra town or the gardens at **Monserrate** if energy allows, Lisbon, Portugal
- Evening: Return to Lisbon for a relaxed dinner near the hotel.
- Rationale: Sintra is the best no-car day trip from Lisbon and gives you the scenic highlight of the trip.
- Estimated cost: Train €16, palace/garden tickets €60, local transport €20, meals €90, total **€186**

## Day 4 — Belém, Riverside Walk, and Departure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Head to **Belém** by tram or train; visit **Jerónimos Monastery** area and walk the riverside.
- Afternoon: Try **pastéis de nata** at a classic bakery, then browse one last museum or simply enjoy the waterfront.
- Evening: Departure or final dinner if your schedule allows.
- Rationale: Belém combines heritage, a scenic stroll, and iconic food without requiring a car.
- Estimated cost: Transit €10, sights €30, meals €80, pastries/coffee €20, total **€140**

# Cost Breakdown and Trip Fit

| Item | Estimated Cost |
|---|---:|
| Hotel, 3 nights | €450 |
| Meals and coffee | €320 |
| Local transit | €50 |
| Museums and entry fees | €140 |
| Sintra day trip | €96 |
| Snacks, pastries, misc. | €120 |
| Buffer for upgrades or extras | €424 |
| Total | **€1,600** |

### Recommended Hotel Area
- **Best fit:** Baixa/Chiado or Rossio
- **Why:** Central, walkable, and directly connected to metro, tram, and train options
- **Trade-off:** Slightly higher nightly rates than outer neighborhoods, but much better for a no-car trip

### Activity Mix Check
- Museums: **2 strong stops**
- Walking neighborhoods: **Alfama, Graça, Mouraria, Belém**
- Scenic day trip: **Sintra**
- Relaxation: **One completely free evening**
- Pace: **Moderate**, with one major outing per day
